description: This file defines a mock class `RfcApiImplMock` for testing, which inherits from `RfcApiImpl` and uses Google Mock to mock three virtual methods related to RFC parameter handling.

classes.name: RfcApiImplMock
classes.description: Mock class for `RfcApiImpl` providing mocked implementations of RFC parameter handling methods for testing purposes.

methods.name: getRFCParameter
methods.description: Mocked method to retrieve an RFC parameter, returns a status code.

methods.name: setRFCParameter
methods.description: Mocked method to set an RFC parameter with a specified data type.

methods.name: getRFCErrorString
methods.description: Mocked method to return a string description of a given WDMP_STATUS code.
